name: @mesh/weather-interface
description: Standard current-conditions and short forecast contract, independent of its providers.

state.name: available
state.description: Whether current conditions have been fetched

state.name: location
state.description: Display name of the forecast location

state.name: temperature
state.description: Current temperature in the provider's unit

state.name: feels_like
state.description: Apparent temperature in the provider's unit

state.name: condition
state.description: Semantic condition: clear, partly-cloudy, cloudy, fog, drizzle, rain, snow or storm

state.name: is_day
state.description: Whether the location is in daylight

state.name: updated_at
state.description: Unix time in seconds of the last successful fetch
